notes.title: French localization is already in the game!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

A small update that includes:


 Adding French to the game. 
 Localization of achievements to the language of the user.
 Small fixes bugs and errors. 


Thanks to everyone who buys the game and writes positive and even negative feedback! Your opinion is very important to me :)

Sincerely yours, Faithy

notes.title: There is a huge pre-release update here!
notes.content:
Hey, hey, hey! Uploaded a huge update and the game is almost ready for release. We'll be experimenting soon!

- Added and tested Steam achievements
- Improved all images
- Added music and sounds
- Added design
- Added full English localization
- Fixed minor bugs, errors
- Made a new trailer

[previewyoutube=QPNKtQ4CV-o;full][/previewyoutube]

The release will be on the 25th, barring any force majeure.
